sql: WITH RECURSIVE x AS (SELECT id, parent_id FROM (SELECT * FROM pg.public.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) orders UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.parent_id FROM (SELECT * FROM pg.public.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $2) o JOIN x ON o.parent_id = x.id) SELECT id FROM x
